meta.title: Frequently asked questions — Mobilcab
meta.description: Straight answers about Mobilcab: installing, tablets, pricing, the Basic plan, and the product roadmap.

hero.label: Frequently asked questions
hero.title: Straight answers, before you sign up.
hero.body: If you can't find what you're looking for, write to us. We answer personally.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
a: No. Mobilcab runs straight from your browser, on laptop, tablet or phone. Nothing to install, no license server.

items.q: Does it work on a tablet?
a: Yes, it's built for laptop, tablet and phone. You can start a project in the workshop and show it to your client on a tablet, on-site.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
a: The cut list (dimensions, quantities, materials) is the workshop foundation.
Dedicated CNC machine export comes at M3 on the roadmap — after nesting is solid. It is not included in the Basic plan at paid launch (M2).

They're the product stages. M1 = Cut list (3D design + parts list — now, free). M2 = nesting, labels and quotes — when billing opens (Atelier / Producție / CNC; FP: 20% off). M3 = CNC export. M4 = team and sharing. M5 = AI + renders.
On the site, you can tap M1–M5 to jump to that stage on the Roadmap page.
The app is free for now and we are not charging subscriptions. If you want 20% off the Basic plan, join the Founding Partner waitlist.

When we ship M2 and open the paid Basic plan (design, cut lists, nesting, labels, quotes), people on the FP waitlist get 20% off list (6 months from first payment). Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. You are not obliged to pay if you do not want to. List amounts are announced at paid launch.

items.q: How is the Free plan different from Basic?
a: The Free plan is for now: design and cut list, with limits (10 rows on screen, 3 downloads per account). Cloud save is unlimited.

At paid launch with M2, the Basic plan is the workshop plan: 3D design, cut list, sheet nesting, labels and client quotes, with unlimited exports. Founding Partners on the waitlist: 20% off; later: list price.
after: We do not charge until the paid Basic plan opens with M2. List prices are confirmed then.
